apps.name: Aidoku
apps.subtitle: Free and open-source manga reader
apps.localizedDescription: Aidoku is a free and open-source manga reader for iOS and iPadOS with no ads and no tracking. Content comes from community-maintained source lists that you add yourself, so nothing is bundled with the app. It downloads chapters for offline reading, syncs library, history and settings through iCloud, supports external trackers, and offers paged, vertical and continuous reading modes with customisable layouts.
apps.versionDescription:
Aidoku 0.9 | Aidoku

- OCR dictionary support (iOS 18+): import Yomitan-compatible dictionaries in the app and look up words while reading.
- Suwayomi built-in source: read and track from a Suwayomi instance, just like Komga and Kavita.
- Auto scroll for webtoon reader: enable and press the play button to scroll without touching your device.
- Fixed CloudFlare handling: CloudFlare issues that caused external sources to break should be resolved.
- Overall performance improvements: the library loads much faster (@Amqx), and the webtoon reader was improved.
- Source stability fixes and disable option: the issue where sources were causing the app to crash should not happen again, and now you can even disable a source that is broken until it receives an update.
- Many more things: see [the website](https://aidoku.app/release-notes/) for a more complete list.

apps.name: BHTwitter
apps.subtitle: X (Twitter) with no ads, downloads and the chronological timeline
apps.localizedDescription: BHTwitter is a long-running tweak for X (formerly Twitter), published as a ready-to-sideload IPA. It hides promoted posts and ads, restores the chronological timeline as the default, and lets you download videos, GIFs and images straight from a post. It also adds Face ID / Touch ID app lock, custom fonts, undo posting, inline translation, direct saving of profile pictures and headers, confirmation prompts for likes and reposts, and switches for hiding the tabs and UI elements you never use.

apps.name: StikDebug
apps.subtitle: On-device JIT enabler and debugger
apps.localizedDescription: StikDebug attaches a debugger to your sideloaded apps directly on device, which enables JIT for emulators and other apps that need it. It uses a pairing file and an on-device VPN loop, so no computer is required after the initial setup. Requires iOS 17.4 or newer.

apps.name: Table Habit
apps.subtitle: Open-source micro-habit tracker with WebDAV sync
apps.localizedDescription: Table Habit is a free, open-source habit tracker for building micro habits: a scoring system grades consistency rather than raw streaks, growth charts show the trend, and everything syncs across devices through any WebDAV endpoint - Nextcloud, Koofr or a self-hosted one. Offline-first, no ads, no in-app purchases and no account required, licensed under Apache-2.0. The iOS build OmniSource tracks is the project's own unsigned IPA from its GitHub releases, which AltStore, SideStore, Feather and ESign sign with your certificate at install time.
apps.versionDescription:
Table Habit 1.27.9 | mhabit-unsigned

# Release: v1.27.9+198

> Includes updates since the previous stable release, v1.27.6+195.

## ✨ Features

- Cycle check-ins from unknown to done, skipped, and back to unknown (#657)
  - Delete a single check-in or several at once with confirmation
  - Sync deletions across devices and keep record identity for later check-ins
- Improve dialogs and page layouts across window sizes (#661)
  - Adapt sheets and dialogs when resizing while preserving the open form
    and navigation state
  - Migrate group management, sync editing, changelog, donation, and about
    dialogs to shared adaptive presentation
  - Keep nested navigation and close confirmation within the active dialog
  - Align scrolling page headers, safe areas, and window-control avoidance
- Improve habit detail actions and refresh retained details when returning
  to them (#662)
- Improve Settings, grouped lists, and dialogs across window sizes (#663)
  - Add date format, reminder, export, import progress, and group editing flows
  - Keep import results and group actions tied to the selected items
- Preserve unknown WebDAV fields when syncing groups and records, improving
  compatibility with newer app versions (#665)

## 🐛 Fixes

- Restore batch check-in actions for selected habits in Apple layouts (#661)
- Preserve Settings scroll position when rebuilding the page (#661)
- Prevent a delayed group save from closing the group selector after the
  user has already returned from the creation form (#661)
- Improve loading error recovery (#662)
- Bound import concurrency and expose failures for individual items (#663)

## 🌐 Localization

- Update Italian translation, thanks to Simone De Carli's contribution on
  Weblate (#664)

[Full Changelog](https://github.com/FriesI23/mhabit/compare/v1.27.6+195...v1.27.9+198)
